title: NodeBench UI Contract capture manifest
description: Describes one dated ui-contract capture folder: the surfaces shot, how, and the before/after proof pairs. Companion to docs/design/UI_CONTRACT.md and src/design/designSystem.ts.

slice.description: Short slug matching the folder suffix, e.g. ai-elements-batch1.

app.description: Repo/app the capture belongs to, e.g. nodebench-ai.

localServer.description: URL the app was served from during capture.

policy.description: What the screenshots prove and do NOT prove (parity caveats).

commitBefore.description: Git ref for the pre-change baseline (migration proof).

commitAfter.description: Git ref for the post-change result (migration proof).

route.description: Normal product path used to reach the surface.

qa.description: Optional Gemini QA receipt JSON filename beside the shot.
